meta.title: Add a health endpoint and redact query tokens in logs
meta.body: Adds a GET /api/health route returning process uptime, and extends the logging redaction to strip `token=` query parameters.

meta.title: Add health and version endpoints and redact query tokens in logs
meta.body: Adds a GET /api/health route returning process uptime, and extends the logging redaction to strip `token=` query parameters. Also adds a GET /api/version route returning the deployed version.
